Catalina Reyes  
📍 Mumbai, India | 📧 catalinareyes.dev | 📞 +91 98765 43210 | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/catalinareyes  

Catalina Reyes, a mid-senior game developer with three years of industry experience, has carved a niche in crafting immersive gaming experiences. Her career began at Nova Studios, where she contributed to the development of a 3D puzzle game leveraging OpenGL for real-time rendering. This role solidified her understanding of 3D graphics pipelines, enabling her to optimize rendering performance by 15% through shader adjustments. Transitioning to Vortex Games, she expanded her expertise in C#/.NET, leading the implementation of a cross-platform multiplayer system that reduced latency by 20% and supported 500+ concurrent players. At Lumina Interactive, her focus shifted to refining game physics and networking systems, where she spearheaded a redesign of collision detection algorithms, improving stability in complex environments. Her work consistently balances technical rigor with creative problem-solving, ensuring seamless player experiences.  

Professional Experience / Work History  
Nova Studios (2020–2021)  
As a Junior Game Developer, Catalina collaborated on a 3D puzzle game, focusing on OpenGL-based rendering and Python scripting for asset management workflows. She integrated REST APIs to synchronize player progress across devices, ensuring data consistency without compromising performance. Her contributions to the game’s physics engine, using a combination of Python and C++, allowed for dynamic object interactions, enhancing user engagement.  

Vortex Games (2021–2022)  
In her role as Game Development Engineer, Catalina led the migration of a legacy game system to Unreal Engine, streamlining asset pipelines and reducing development time by 25%. She implemented Rust-based systems for memory management, cutting garbage collection overhead by 30%. Her work on Web performance optimization, particularly for browser-based demos, improved load times by 40%, directly impacting user retention metrics.  

Lumina Interactive (2022–Present)  
As a Mid-Senior Game Developer, Catalina oversees the architecture of a AAA title, prioritizing scalable C#/.NET solutions for backend services. She designed a custom networking layer using Unity, achieving 99.9% packet reliability in high-traffic scenarios. Her focus on game physics resulted in a 22% reduction in CPU usage during complex interactions, while her leadership in cross-functional teams ensured timely delivery of core features.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
C#/.NET: Engineered scalable backend services for a multiplayer game, achieving 50% faster data processing through asynchronous workflows. Implemented a modular architecture for a Unity project, reducing maintenance overhead by 35%.  
Unreal Engine: Redesigned a game’s lighting system using Vulkan, improving frame rates by 28% on high-end GPUs. Integrated procedural generation tools to expand world-building capabilities.  
Game Physics: Optimized collision detection algorithms, reducing computational load by 22% while maintaining precision in dynamic environments.  
Unity: Built a cross-platform analytics system, integrating REST APIs to track player behavior without third-party tools.  
Game Networking: Developed a custom synchronization protocol, ensuring 99.9% latency consistency across 100+ players in real-time scenarios.  
Rust: Refactored memory-intensive systems, achieving a 30% reduction in garbage collection pauses.  
Web Performance Optimization: Enhanced browser-based game demos, cutting load times by 40% through resource bundling and lazy loading.  
Python: Automated asset management pipelines, streamlining workflows for 15+ artists and reducing manual errors by 50%.  
REST API Design: Created a secure, scalable API for player data synchronization, supporting 500+ concurrent requests without performance degradation.  
3D Graphics (OpenGL/Vulkan): Optimized rendering pipelines for a AAA title, achieving 15% better frame rates on Vulkan-enabled hardware.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Spanish (professional working proficiency), Hindi (native)  

Projects / Side Projects  
1. **Cross-Platform Game Optimization Tool**: Developed a Unity plugin to analyze and optimize asset loading, reducing startup times by 35% in benchmark tests.  
2. **Networking Stress Test Framework**: Built a Python-based tool to simulate high-concurrency scenarios, identifying bottlenecks in a multiplayer game’s latency model.  
3. **Physics Engine Prototype**: Created a simplified physics engine using C++ and Python, demonstrating realistic collision responses for educational purposes.  
4. **REST API for Game Analytics**: Designed a secure API to track in-game metrics, enabling data-driven decisions without external services.
